summary: The LLM landscape in 2026 is dominated by a handful of frontier families from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, with rapidly improving open-weight challengers from DeepSeek, Meta, and Mistral driving costs down dramatically. Enterprise adoption increasingly flows through cloud aggregators (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx), which significantly amplifies the real-world reach of models available on those platforms. Open-weight models have matured enough to deliver roughly 90% of frontier performance at a fraction of the cost, reshaping developer choice.

models.name: GPT-5
models.popularity_notes: OpenAI's flagship remains the most-called model across direct API and Azure OpenAI, giving it unmatched enterprise aggregator reach alongside the largest developer base.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications requiring reliable reasoning and broad tool support

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic's Sonnet line is the preferred coding model among developers and is available through AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex, driving heavy enterprise adoption.
models.best_for: Software engineering, coding agents, and complex multi-step tasks

models.name: Gemini 3 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Gemini 3 (released November 2025) with Deep Think reasoning is natively integrated into Google Vertex AI and Workspace, giving it enormous enterprise and developer distribution.
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis and multimodal enterprise workloads

models.name: GPT-5 mini
models.popularity_notes: The cost-efficient GPT-5 variant drives huge call volume for high-throughput applications and is widely available via Azure OpenAI.

models.name: Gemini 3 Flash
models.popularity_notes: The Flash tier offers a 1M-token context at very low cost and is heavily adopted for high-volume developer workloads through Vertex AI.
models.best_for: Cost-sensitive, high-throughput tasks needing large context

models.name: DeepSeek V3.2
models.popularity_notes: DeepSeek V3.2 delivers roughly 90% of frontier performance at ~1/50th the cost, driving massive open-weight adoption and HuggingFace downloads.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: The fast, inexpensive Claude tier is widely used for scaled agentic and classification tasks and is available across Bedrock and Vertex AI.
models.best_for: High-volume agentic subtasks and lightweight coding

models.name: Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: Meta's Llama family remains the most-downloaded open-weight model on HuggingFace and is available through AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI.
models.best_for: Custom fine-tuning and on-premise open-weight deployments

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: A 671B-parameter MoE reasoning specialist (37B active) popular for math and algorithmic tasks at low cost, with strong open-weight adoption.
models.best_for: Reasoning-heavy, math, and algorithmic problem solving

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Mistral's flagship is widely adopted in Europe and available through Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Vertex AI, broadening its enterprise reach.
